verdict.rationale: Rippling describes itself as a single source of truth for employee data (HR). It says role changes and departures automatically update access, permissions and groups, and that dynamic rules provision accounts and group access as roles change. Its identity layer federates out to AD, LDAP, SCIM and SAML apps, so joiner/mover/leaver events can flow into the directory and app assignments. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the HR-to-directory sync mechanics (e.g., attribute mapping into AD), an explicit description of joiner-triggered app provisioning, and any independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing-level claims.
